rules.rule: Delete a worktree's vendor/ directory only once its work is confirmed captured in the committed 0002 patch.
To confirm a vendor/ source change is captured, grep for it in the committed 0002 patch file.
Before removing a worktree, merge or cherry-pick its durable scripts and verdict docs to main.
Before removing a worktree, confirm the durable scripts and verdict docs are committed.
Never implement the ML-05 anti-patterns without the owner's written approval.
For the Astera Online project, read the repository files (CLAUDE.md, docs) rather than reconstructing product mission, decisions, balance numbers, or current state from memory.
When writing or fixing a test, find the root cause first.
Do not force tests to fit the code; establish whether the test or the code is wrong before changing either.
Before every game-facing change, consult the game-dev-handbook and apply the principles that fit Astera.
